author: Axiom I
title: Joint v2.7 inversion (rebase01 corr; grangerF variants)
abstract: Create joint_metrics_v2_7_var_granger_inverted.csv by adding corr_inv (rebase01), granger_F_inv (rebase01, clipped), granger_F_z (zscore), granger_F_neg (negate) to the joint v2.7 VAR-Granger CSV.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys
IN  = os.path.join("storage","shared","agency_lab","analyses","csv","joint_metrics_v2_7_var_granger.csv")
OUT = os.path.join("storage","shared","agency_lab","analyses","csv","joint_metrics_v2_7_var_granger_inverted.csv")

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(IN):
        print("WARN missing:", IN); return 0
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.utilities.inverted_metrics_adapter_v0_1 import read_csv, write_csv, invert_rows
    rows = read_csv(IN)
    if not rows:
        print("WARN empty input:", IN); return 0
    rows = invert_rows(rows, ["corr"], method="rebase01", suffix="_inv")      # corr_inv
    rows = invert_rows(rows, ["granger_F"], method="rebase01", suffix="_inv") # granger_F_inv (clipped)
    rows = invert_rows(rows, ["granger_F"], method="zscore",   suffix="_z")   # granger_F_z
    rows = invert_rows(rows, ["granger_F"], method="negate",   suffix="_neg") # granger_F_neg
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    write_csv(OUT, rows)
    print("WROTE", OUT, "rows=", len(rows))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
